profile.summary: Jensen Hughes is an engineering and consulting company that works on fire protection and other safety issues in buildings. Its services include fire system design and testing, code consulting, building commissioning, and structural, mechanical and electrical design. It has offices in North America, Europe, the United Kingdom, Asia, the Pacific and the Middle East.
